freelancingStores.subject: A lighter custom feature for {{store_name}}
freelancingStores.body:
Hi there,

I came across {{store_name}} and wanted to reach out. If your team is paying for third-party apps to cover store features that could live directly in the theme, I can help replace the slow or expensive pieces with clean, maintainable custom Liquid functionality.

I am a full-stack developer focused on Shopify, custom Liquid, React, Remix, GraphQL, Node.js, and Shopify Admin APIs. I have delivered 90+ custom Shopify stores and focus on improving the storefront without adding unnecessary app overhead.

If you have one feature in mind, send it over and I can suggest whether a custom build would be a good fit. You can see examples of my work here: https://himanshusoni-lilac.vercel.app/

Would a short conversation next week be useful?

Best,
Himanshu
Shopify Full-Stack Developer
+919302615727

appDevelopers.subject: Extra Shopify app development capacity for {{app_name}}
appDevelopers.body:
Hi {{app_name}} team,

Full-Stack Shopify Developer

agencies.subject: White-label Shopify development support for {{agency_name}}
agencies.body:
Hello {{agency_name}} team,

I provide reliable white-label Shopify development support for agencies when client timelines exceed in-house capacity. I strictly adhere to your Figma-to-Liquid specifications, including layout, responsive behavior, design details, and interactions, and I raise questions early to avoid rework.

My work includes custom Liquid sections, Shopify theme builds, React, Remix, GraphQL, Node.js, and Shopify Admin APIs. I have delivered 50+ custom Shopify stores and can take on clearly scoped overflow work while keeping communication and delivery aligned with your agency.

If you have upcoming overflow work, I would be happy to discuss how I can support your team.

Best regards,
Himanshu
Full Stack Shopify Developer
